QuestInfo.2: Blae hung the moon, if you ask me.

0.msg: It's Blae. I've picked the stars, so to speak.

1.msg: Why are being you nice all of a sudden?

2.msg:
I don't really have 'belongings' per se,
so I can't shower you with gifts like my sister does.
So instead, I picked this myself and put it in a glass jar.
#i3801549

4.msg:
Oh, don't get ahead of yourself. 
This isn't free. 
First, you have to equip the whole #e#bMilky Way Night set#k#n. 
Once you've put the whole set on, come talk to me.
#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)

yes.0: I'll be waiting with #i3018590# #b#t3018590##k.\nOh, and there's a time limit, so hurry back.

0.msg: You cold-hearted little thing. Just give them to me, will you?

1.msg: No. I'll get in trouble with my sister.

2.msg: You're a couple of cold-hearted brats!
